newsitem.title: USA: Maine governor to veto cigarette tax increase.
newsitem.headline: Maine governor to veto cigarette tax increase.

text.p: Maine Gov. Angus King said over the weekend that he will veto on Monday a bill doubling the cigarette tax because of a dispute with lawmakers over how the revenue would be used.
The state Legislature approved an increase in the per-pack cigarette tax to $0.74 from $0.37 to provide health insurance to low-income children and prescription drugs to needy senior citizens.
King, who originally proposed the tax increase in an effort to curb smoking by teenagers, said he wants the money to be used for income tax relief. His proposal was defeated by lawmakers last month.
King, who made his comments at the State House this weekend, said he may again attempt to increase the tax when lawmakers return to session June 19 to review vetoed legislation.
